reader.requirement: At --std 85 END-START must terminate the START begun by the most recently preceding unterminated START (with or without INVALID KEY / NOT INVALID KEY phrases), so that statements after it belong to the enclosing scope, a conditional phrase after an inner END-START associates with the enclosing START, and an END-START with no open START is refused; a separator period or the containing statement's next phrase still terminates an unterminated START implicitly (§1985:IV.6.4.3).

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable per general format of the owning statement; START's one INVALID KEY pair format carries no construct, so the association is the same at every edition
InForce (Year < 2002): a phrase-less START needs a USE procedure at 85 (SR3); unrelated to the terminator

reader.edition-search: The terminator itself is the grammar's optional END_START token at the end of startStatement; grep of CobolIO.g4/CobolParserCore.g4 for END_START and of ConditionalPhrases.cs for Edition shows no edition predicate on the terminator.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pb333 writes END-START after each START of a flat sequence; it does not exercise nesting (inner END-START returning a NOT INVALID KEY phrase to the outer START), END-START inside IF or inside another verb's imperative, the phrase-less delimited START, or a stray END-START.

probes.printed: E1 INV 23 / E1 AFTER IN IF; E2 ELSE; E3 OUTER INV / E3 STILL OUTER INV / E3 AFTER 00 (NOT INVALID KEY after the inner END-START went to the outer START); E4 OUTER NOTINV; E5 INNER NOTINV / E5 AFTER INNER (OUTER INV) (without an inner terminator the phrase goes to the inner START); E6 INV / E6 AFTER PERIOD
probes.expected: §1985:IX.4.7.4 GR9 with §1985:IV.6.4.3: terminator closes the most recent unterminated START; phrases attach to the nearest unterminated START that admits them; the period terminates implicitly

reader.notes: END-START is the greedy optional token of startStatement, so ANTLR closes the innermost open START; the phrase-association predicate hands NOT INVALID KEY to the enclosing START once the inner one is closed. Every nesting probe matched §1985:IV.6.4.3; no edition arm touches the terminator.
